title: Staff Backend Engineer (Ruby), AI Engineering: DAP Repository Flows
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

The DAP Repository Flows team owns two areas within GitLab's Duo Agent Platform (DAP). The first is DAP onboarding, helping customers quickly set up a project so they can start using the Duo Agent Platform with minimal friction. The second is repository and background flows: autonomous and scheduled agents that work on a customer's codebase on their behalf.

This work is central to how GitLab delivers AI-powered automation on repositories. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will set technical direction for the team, drive complex initiatives across team boundaries, and raise the engineering bar for how we build agentic experiences on top of the Duo Agent Platform.

What you'll do in this role

  • Set and drive the technical direction for the DAP Repository Flows team, making architecture decisions that shape how onboarding and repository/background flows are built.
  • Lead the design and delivery of autonomous and scheduled agents that operate on customer codebases, building on top of the Duo Agent Platform.
  • Design and refine the DAP onboarding experience so customers can get a project configured and productive quickly.
  • Partner across teams in the broader DAP organization to align on interfaces, shared patterns, and platform capabilities.
  • Mentor senior and intermediate engineers, review designs and code, and elevate the team's overall technical quality.
  • Identify and resolve the hardest technical problems the team faces, and prevent them where possible through sound design.
  • Contribute to a culture of autonomy, ownership, high context sharing, and async-first collaboration.

What we're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails in production systems.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating LLMs into products (product integration, not ML model training).
  • Experience building agentic systems: autonomous or semi-autonomous agents that take actions on a user's behalf.
  • A track record of designing and shipping complex, high-scale systems and driving technical direction across teams.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to operate effectively in a distributed, async-first environment.
  • The judgment and influence expected of a staff-level engineer: setting direction, unblocking others, and multiplying the team's impact.

About the team

The DAP Repository Flows team is part of GitLab's broader Duo Agent Platform organization, within the AI/R&D group. The team is small and distributed, with plans to grow. We value autonomy, ownership, and high context sharing, and we work async-first through GitLab issues and Slack.

Remote-Global

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.
